evidence.basis: I independently checked this premise against original evidence, including the current required negative finding, without reading or adopting a domain pass. The repaired FVC table correctly separates observed week-12 values in Figure 2a (60 mg QD n=10, 98.4 mL, CI 10.9 to 185.9; placebo n=14, -20.3 mL, CI -116.1 to 75.6) from Figure 2b's baseline-adjusted ANCOVA with multiple imputation under MAR (randomized n=18/17; 89.2 mL, CI -8.7 to 187.2, and -8.2 mL, CI -98.1 to 81.7). The original figure was visually read. Registry absolute-FVC results independently preserve the observed denominators and values in L and the separate LS means/intervals. Unit conversion and the two descriptive subtractions, 118.7 and 97.4 mL, agree; the manuscript does not claim they are newly estimated randomized contrasts with confidence intervals. Main-article methods confirm 22 missing week-12 measurements (5/6/8/3), baseline covariate, MAR and safety-first study sizing. The safety, related-AE, related-SAE, discontinuation and completion counts agree with the original article/Table 2. The article supports seven liver-related withdrawals, four with nintedanib, and three versus one exacerbations; the manuscript preserves uncertainty and avoids causal interaction claims. Reporting Summary pp.1-3 are actually a reporting summary, including the separate two-baseline-outlier sensitivity analysis, not a full protocol/SAP. The discovery original supports constrained PandaOmics target prioritization, Chemistry42 pocket/interaction design, synthesis and measured ADME liabilities driving optimization, binding/kinase/cellular checks and three IPF donor fibroblast observations; it does not establish a randomized AI efficiency advantage, and the manuscript does not claim one. Its approximately 18-month clock is preclinical nomination, distinct from later trials. Phase III registry fields support oral IPF, actual start 2026-09-09, recruiting, estimated enrollment 320, 52-week FVC decline and first posting 2026-07-07. The directly cited company page is dated 2026-09-10; the retained PRNewswire copy is dated 2026-09-09. The manuscript's September 10 announcement attribution matches its actual linked company page. April 28 inhalation IND clearance supports a planned separate phase I branch, not oral phase III status or proven dosing. No necessary evidence correction remains within this premise scope.
